about: Log 400 held-out set, written 2026-10-10 before any run, for the free-model fallback alone. Ordinary request forms (statements and questions mixed), cores not used in heldout1-8 or traps.json: unsupported tasks, near misses that sit close to a registered result, partial requests, and controls in plain or unusual wording.

items.core: haplotype phasing
items.prompt: We genotyped 800 trios on an array. We want to phase each child's genotypes into the two parental haplotypes.

items.core: codon optimization for expression in E. coli
items.prompt: We need to express a human enzyme in E. coli. Can you optimize the codons of its coding sequence for high expression?

items.core: microsatellite instability status
items.prompt: From tumor-normal exome pairs of 140 colorectal cancers, we want to classify each tumor as microsatellite stable or unstable.

items.core: antibody epitope prediction
items.prompt: We have the sequence of a viral surface protein. Which regions are most likely to be recognized by neutralizing antibodies?

items.core: cell-cycle phase assignment for single cells
items.prompt: We have 9,000 single cells from a proliferating culture. We want to assign each cell to G1, S or G2/M.

items.core: per-base evolutionary conservation scores
items.prompt: For 300 candidate enhancers we want per-base conservation scores across 100 vertebrate genomes.

items.core: adapter trimming and read quality control
items.prompt: Our raw FASTQ files have adapter contamination and low-quality tails. Which tool should trim and quality-filter the reads before mapping?

items.core: retrotransposon insertion calls
items.prompt: From whole-genome sequencing of 60 neurons, we want to detect somatic LINE-1 insertions in each neuron.

items.core: a dynamic Bayesian network linking consecutive time points
items.prompt: We sampled expression at 12 time points after stimulation, with TF motifs. We want a dynamic Bayesian network in which each time point's regulation depends on the previous one.

items.core: communities of a tripartite miRNA-TF-gene network
items.prompt: We have a network with three node types: miRNAs, TFs and genes. Is there a method that finds communities spanning all three node types at once?

items.core: a hypergraph of cooperating TF complexes
items.prompt: With motifs, PPI and expression from 110 samples, we want a hypergraph in which each hyperedge is a TF complex jointly regulating a gene.

items.core: a separate network for each allele
items.prompt: We have allele-specific expression from 50 heterozygous donors. We want a separate regulatory network for each allele of each donor.

items.core: tracking how communities split and merge across time points
items.prompt: We have TF-gene networks at five developmental stages. Which method tracks how the communities split and merge from one stage to the next?

items.core: edge weights calibrated as probabilities of direct binding
items.prompt: From motifs, PPI and liver expression, we want every TF-gene edge weight to be a calibrated probability that the TF physically binds that gene.

items.core: a two-layer network from single-cell measurements
items.prompt: We have paired single-cell RNA and single-cell ATAC from 4,000 cells. We want a partial-correlation network between the two layers computed across the individual cells.

items.core: TF activity for each TF isoform separately
items.prompt: Several TFs in our data have isoforms with opposite functions. Is there a method that estimates a separate activity for each TF isoform in each sample?

items.core: miRNAs as targets regulated by TFs
items.prompt: We have mRNA and miRNA from 70 samples. We want a network in which TFs are the regulators and the miRNA genes are their targets.

items.core: a TF-gene network inferred without any TF-gene prior
items.prompt: We study a non-model organism with no motif database and no binding data. We want a TF-gene regulatory network inferred from the expression of 120 samples alone, without any prior on which TF binds which gene.

items.core: drug repurposing ranking per community
items.prompt: We have a TF-gene edge list from a fibrosis study. We want its communities, and then a ranking of approved drugs that could target each community.

items.core: siRNA design against the top TFs
items.prompt: From expression, motifs and PPI in 60 samples, we want each TF's activity per sample, and then siRNA sequences designed against the ten most active TFs.

items.core: a KEGG-style pathway diagram
items.prompt: We measured proteins and metabolites in 75 patients. Is there a method that links the two layers with direct conditional associations and then draws the result as a KEGG-style pathway diagram?

items.core: miRNA half-life estimates
items.prompt: We have small RNA and mRNA from 90 samples. We want a network of TF and miRNA regulation, and also an estimate of each miRNA's half-life.

items.core: copy-number calls from the exomes
items.prompt: We have exome sequencing from 260 tumors. We want pathway-level mutation scores to subtype the patients, and copy-number change calls from the same exomes.

items.core: one consensus TF-target map across all samples
items.prompt: From 180 adipose samples with motif and PPI priors, we want a single consensus map of which TFs target which genes across all the samples.

items.core: one TF-target map per donor
items.prompt: We have expression, motifs and PPI for 64 donors. Which method gives one TF-target map per donor so we can relate the wiring to BMI?

items.core: one network using TargetScan microRNA predictions and TF motifs
items.prompt: Besides TF motifs, our priors include TargetScan predictions for microRNAs. We want one network for the whole dataset that uses both kinds of regulators.

items.core: TF and microRNA regulation for every sample
items.prompt: We have mRNA and microRNA profiles from 55 tumors. We want to see both TF and microRNA regulation for every tumor separately.

items.core: each TF's effect on each target as a positive or negative number
items.prompt: With expression, motifs and PPI from 100 heart samples, we want each TF's effect on each of its targets as a positive or a negative number.

items.core: per-sample TF activity that does not mirror the TF's transcript
items.prompt: Is there a method that scores each TF's activity in each of our 70 samples without simply mirroring the TF's own transcript level?

items.core: direct links between proteomics and phosphoproteomics with significance
items.prompt: We have proteomics and phosphoproteomics from 95 tumors. We want the direct links between the two layers, with a significance value for each link.

items.core: a per-participant network between lipids and gene expression
items.prompt: We measured plasma lipids and blood gene expression in 80 participants. Which method gives each participant a network between the lipid and expression layers?

items.core: modules of a TF-to-gene edge list and the most central TFs in each
items.prompt: We want to split our existing TF-to-gene edge list into modules and find which TFs are most central inside each module.

items.core: a gene-gene correlation network specific to each sample
items.prompt: From 45 pancreatic samples, we want a gene-gene correlation network specific to each sample.

items.core: co-expression that changes with smoking, adjusting for age
items.prompt: Is there a method that shows which co-expression changes with smoking status in our 160 lung samples, after adjusting for age?

items.core: pathway-level mutation subtypes
items.prompt: We have somatic mutations for 250 patients. We want to aggregate them by pathway and group the patients into subtypes.
